decision: Plan drafted per operator directive 2026-06-12: audit-harness hygiene BEFORE integration-actions or any new product feature - the two follow-ups share the trust boundary that just produced a real hollow verdict (PR #46). One small plan, two features (writer sanitization, append-only iterations), both in completion_dispatch's writer seam.
rationale: Tighten the audit substrate while the failure is fresh; same boundary, one worktree.

decision: Path fields on the transcript (transcript_path/envelope_path) persist in PLACEHOLDERED form; the writer recomputes real output paths from plan_dir/auditor/iteration. Tests and any tooling must derive disk locations from the plan dir, not un-placeholder the recorded strings (username can appear in tmp paths outside $HOME, e.g. pytest-of-<user>, making reversal impossible).
rationale: Sanitization must cover path fields too (they leaked the home dir + username); making them informational-only keeps one canonical path-derivation seam and avoids a reversible-encoding trap.
